title: The Claude Skills Starter Kit: 10 Skills to Install Today, and Ideas for Every Job
summary: Ten ready-made Claude skills to download, how to install and use them in Claude and Claude Code, skills worth having for eighteen kinds of work, and how to make and check your own.

downloads.name: claude-skills-starter-kit.zip
downloads.title: All ten skills
downloads.about: For Claude Code: unzip it into ~/.claude/skills/. In the Claude apps, upload the skills one at a time.

downloads.title: clarify-first
downloads.about: Asks one question at a time until the task is clear, then writes a brief.

downloads.title: brief-builder
downloads.about: Turns a brain dump or call notes into a clear task brief.

downloads.title: natural-voice
downloads.about: Edits a draft so it reads like a person wrote it, keeping every fact.

downloads.title: persuasive-copy
downloads.about: Headlines, landing pages, emails and ads, with variants to test.

downloads.title: co-write
downloads.about: Writes a long document with you, from outline to a newcomer's read-through.

downloads.title: plain-technical-english
downloads.about: Rewrites procedures in Simplified Technical English style, with a checking script.

downloads.title: session-handoff
downloads.about: A one-page handoff note, so a fresh chat can carry on.

downloads.title: idea-to-website
downloads.about: Plan, design, build, GitHub and deploy: from idea to a live site.

downloads.title: analyze-data
downloads.about: Answers data questions and checks joins, duplicates and definitions first.

downloads.title: skill-maker
downloads.about: Makes, checks and packages a new skill with you. Includes the template.

downloads.name: SKILL-template.md
downloads.title: SKILL.md template
downloads.about: A blank skill to fill in: frontmatter, steps, rules, example and checklist.

downloads.title: Cheat sheet
downloads.about: One page: installing, using and making skills, and the ten in this kit.
